sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Biocompatible Dental Ceramic Blocks and Milling Discs

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - United States-pattern statutory corporate law (Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law), English common law principles, and customary law preserved under Constitution Article X
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) (signed 2017, in force 2020)
No comprehensive double taxation agreement in force; non-resident Business Corporations are tax-exempt under the RMI Internal Revenue Act 1989

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (Pub. L. 1990-83) as amended, including the Business Corporations (Amendment) Act 2020 (UBO register and registered agent due diligence obligations); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended) and Regulations; Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act 2020; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Directives and APG mutual evaluation standards

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Passport / National Identity Document of each Proposed Director and Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be notarized, authenticated by the competent authority of the issuing state (e.g., U.S. Department of State Authentication Office) and thereafter legalized by the RMI Consular Office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and Source of Funds / Source of Wealth Statement (AML/CFT Act 2012, Section 13)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public jointly with each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - RMI not party to the Hague Apostille Convention; descendant path via competent authority authentication then RMI Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter or Professional Legal / Accounting Reference for each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Residence bank or licensed professional services firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for bank-origin letters; acceptable alternative is notarized attestation by the issuer where bank internal policy prohibits consular handling

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Clearance / Name Reservation issued by the Registrar of Corporations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not applicable - issued directly by the RMI Registrar to the licensed registered agent; no consular legalization required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screen of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and RMI FIU advisory lists prior to onboarding; enhanced due diligence mandatory for PEPs, family members, and close associates for a minimum of 12 months after PEP status ceases; ongoing transaction monitoring and re-screening at least annually or upon material events; risk-based approach codified under AML/CFT Act 2012 Sections 12-19 and FIU Guidance Notes; denial of service for any match confirmed after investigation without a lawful licensing waiver

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands - electronic name search and reservation executed exclusively through licensed resident registered agents (Association of Registered Agents); public index portal: rmicorporates.org
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official corporate language; name must be expressed in Latin/English characters; no native script is required; any foreign-language corporate name must be transliterated into Latin characters and a verified transliteration certificate must be lodged with the registered agent; the name must be distinguishable from all registered entities, foreign entities registered to do business, and reserved names
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Holding (only permissible with factual holding-company structure)
Dental Board (protected statutory professional designation, requires Ministry of Health consent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the licensed registered agent must file a written administrative appeal / request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, citing Business Corporations Act Sections 14-16 and attaching a certificate of non-conflict and, where applicable, the written consent of the relevant regulatory authority for sensitive tokens; the Registrar must issue a written decision within 15 business days; a further rejection may be challenged by judicial review filed in the RMI High Court within 30 days of the adverse administrative decision; name reservation may be renewed for successive 30-day periods upon payment of the renewal fee prior to expiry, provided the reservation has not lapsed

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible - a non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a registered office at the principal office of its licensed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; no physical business premises, local staff, or in-country operational footprint is required for an ISIC 3250 dental consumables manufacturing entity conducting all production and sales offshore; the registered agent's address functions as the statutory virtual office; a physical mailing address in the RMI is not a substitute for the registered agent requirement under BCA Section 47
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection below 5% for a Low_Risk_Standard non-resident manufacturing entity; RMI Registrar and FIU generally do not perform physical premises inspections of non-resident corporations absent a red-flag trigger, regulatory complaint, sanctions match, or a formal APG/IMF review cycle; the registered agent's office, however, may receive files and records inspection upon lawful authority during AML/CFT oversight

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name clearance and name reservation filing fee (Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 16 procedure)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (collected through licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registrar statutory tariff schedule - Name Reservation Fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation filing fee - authorized capital up to USD 50,000 (BCA Section 32)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office annual retainer (BCA Section 47)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Association of Registered Agents (ARA) licensed agent in Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident Business Corporation maintenance and regulatory correspondence handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register profiling, KYC/AML onboarding, and PEP/sanctions screening of all proposed UBOs, directors, and shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent AML compliance officer / RMI reporting entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per AML/CFT Act 2012 Sections 13-19 customer due diligence obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, competent authority authentication, and RMI consular legalization bundle for founder identification and UBO declaration documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, competent authentication authority of issuing state (e.g., U.S. Department of State), and RMI Consular Office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule plus prevailing legalization and courier service benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Supplementary exact-match and trademark-conflict name search across RMI trade names, Pacific-registry entities, and dental industry marks
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed search agent / RMI Trade Marks Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate and trademark availability search report

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified document translation/transliteration support and expedited courier of legalization packages
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Service vendor and licensed registered agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code), applicable incorporation sections, including Sections 24–31 (filing, articles of incorporation, registered office and agent) and Section 38 (powers of board of directors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), Ministry of Finance, Majuro Atoll.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Business Corporation non-resident form), filed in duplicate with the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The RMI Business Corporations Act imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital or capital escrow requirement. The Articles of Incorporation state authorized share capital; fully paid and non-assessable shares may be issued upon board resolution and receipt of subscription consideration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation, being duly organized under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, does hereby: (1) approve and accept the subscriptions for the shares set forth in the subscription agreements and direct the Secretary to issue share certificates upon payment in full; (2) adopt the registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands as the Corporation's statutory seat and designate the registered agent named in the Articles of Incorporation; (3) appoint the individuals listed in the Incorporation Checklist as President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual meeting; and (4) authorize the officers to execute all documents, open bank accounts, and engage advisors necessary to commence lawful business operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations (online filing portal and email submission to registrar@register-rmi.net)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for the proposed entity, ensuring the corporate suffix 'Business Corporation' or 'BC' is included. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered entities. Upon approval, the name is held for a statutory reservation period.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name in Latin script
Entity type and country of formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for confusing similarity, file a revised name reservation with supporting distinguishing elements or obtain a written consent letter from the prior holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator signs the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, authorized share structure, registered office address, registered agent name, and non-resident status. Attach the subscription statement for initial shareholders and acknowledge limited liability.
required_dossiers: Statement of non-resident business corporation status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles are rejected for formal defects, correct the deficiency on the face of the Articles and re-file within 10 business days; no re-processing fee applies for clerical corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the executed Articles along with the prescribed filing fee and government receipt to the Registrar. Payment may be made by wire transfer to the RMI Ministry of Finance account or by official bank draft. Retain the confirmation of payment for issuance of the certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for missing signatures, bank stamp, or fee discrepancy, provide the corrected document or revised payment confirmation within 14 calendar days to avoid abandonment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful filing and fee clearance, the Registrar endorses the Certificate of Incorporation and returns the certified copy to the registered agent. Verify the certificate date and corporate number for subsequent licensing and banking use.
required_dossiers: Attorney or registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed beyond SLA, submit a written follow-up request to the Registrar with proof of payment and request expedited certification for an additional statutory expedite fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Directors and Undertaking of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or initial directors sign a consent in lieu of an organizational meeting and adopt the First Board Resolution. The resolution must be recorded in the corporate records book and signed by each director.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If directors fail to sign, re-convene the board by written unanimous consent or call an emergency meeting with minimum statutory notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the registered office is a physical address in the Marshall Islands and that a licensed RMI registered agent has accepted service of process. File any change of registered office or agent with the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent declines service, promptly appoint a substitute licensed agent and file the statement of change on RMI Form RA-02.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of Corporate Book, Seal and Share Certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the corporate minute book containing the bylaws, initial resolutions, share certificate ledger, and stock transfer register. Issue share certificates to subscribers only against receipt of paid-up capital.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If share capital records contain discrepancies, issue corrected certificates and board ratification resolution to cure any unauthorized issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Employer Identification Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI commercial banks and Ministry of Finance / Tax Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account for non-resident operations using the certified Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution. Obtain the RMI tax identification number and any required business registration endorsement for payroll or importation purposes.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution appointing bank signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank due diligence requests further proof, provide an apostilled certificate and a legal opinion from RMI counsel confirming good standing and non-resident tax status.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Health and Human Services (Competent Authority for Medical Device and Dental Material Manufacturing) in coordination with the RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMIEPA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing and Distributing License for Dental Medical Devices (Dental Ceramic Blocks and CAD/CAM Discs) under the RMI Medical Products Regulatory Framework.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C — Environmental Registration (low-impact manufacturing; full EIA not required for closed-system ceramic pressing, presintering and CAD/CAM milling solely employing zirconia, alumina and non-hazardous binders).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Process wastewater must meet RMIEPA discharge thresholds: pH 6.5–8.5, total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 15 mg/L, and no visible airborne dust plume from milling or grinding emissions. Airborne respirable zirconia dust must be controlled to ≤ 5 mg/m3 (8-hour TWA), with local exhaust ventilation and HEPA filtration where machining occurrs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The facility must obtain a Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the Majuro Fire Department, including compliance with the NFPA 1 Fire Code for kiln and heat-treatment operations. A structural load inspection certificate for the kiln area and a workplace occupational safety clearance for noise, dust, and machine guarding must be issued by the Occupational Safety and Health Compliance Unit of the Ministry of Health and Human Services before commencement of production.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands – Revenue and Tax Division; online portal: https://rmi-finance.org (limited e-filing, physical filings accepted through registered agents)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident business corporations are not automatically issued an RMI Taxpayer Identification Number. A TIN is required only when the entity undertakes taxable RMI activities such as employer registration, customs importer registration, or local business licensing. The foreign entity must submit a completed TIN registration application, certified certificate of incorporation, bylaws, certificate of good standing issued by the Registrar of Corporations, and proof of a registered agent in RMI. The Revenue and Tax Division processes applications within 5-10 business days. No VAT identification number is issued because the Marshall Islands imposes no value-added tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No domestic check-the-box or entity classification election exists under Marshall Islands law. Non-resident business corporations are statutorily classified as non-resident entities exempt from RMI income tax. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized for RMI domestic tax purposes, although the RMI has participated in BEPS-related dialogue. Separate US federal check-the-box elections, such as IRS Form 8832, may be used by US taxpayers but have no effect on RMI tax status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No National VAT/GST – Limited Import Excise Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – RMI has no VAT/GST registration threshold. The official currency is the US Dollar (USD). Importers must obtain an RMI business license and customs clearance before goods are landed, regardless of value, subject only to limited de minimis allowances for personal effects.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API reporting mandate exists. Customs import declarations are processed electronically through the RMI Customs Division platform (ASYCUDA World). Clearance is based on commercial invoices, bills of lading, packing lists, and duty assessment. No invoice clearance API is imposed on exporters.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in RMI as there is no VAT to zero-rate. Exports of dental zirconia blocks and milling discs manufactured in the Marshall Islands are outside the scope of Marshall Islands consumption taxation and are not subject to import excise tax. A certificate of origin and export documentation are nonetheless required to evidence that the goods departed RMI and to support buyer-side duty relief in the destination jurisdiction.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because RMI has no VAT system, there is no export-VAT refund mechanism and no fraudulent zero-rating clawback regime. Export and customs fraud is nevertheless penalized under the RMI Customs Act: false declarations, undervaluation, or misdescription of exported or imported goods may result in forfeiture of goods, monetary penalties up to three times the value of the goods, suspension or revocation of customs and excise licenses, and criminal fines or imprisonment for responsible officers. The RMI Revenue and Tax Division may audit records for up to six years and impose administrative penalties for inaccurate documentation supporting any tax exemption claim.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no central bank. Prudential regulation and licensing of financial institutions are administered by the Banking Commissioner of the Ministry of Finance under the Banking Act 2005 (as amended). The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender by law, and the Financial Intelligence Unit under the Currency and Transactions Reporting Act and the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 supervises AML/CFT compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility exists by design because the U.S. dollar is the circulating legal tender; RMI imposes no exchange controls and no separate capital or current account restrictions on equity injections, trade settlements, dividend remittances, or profit repatriation. The operative constraints are bank-level AML/CFT reporting and record-keeping for cash and wire transactions of USD 10,000 or above, plus U.S. OFAC screening in the correspondent clearing chain. No central bank permit, no exchange-rate approval, and no conversion license is required for any transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI statutes impose no export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export receipts. Dental zirconia block export proceeds may be retained in USD or any foreign currency at the exporter's choice; the only practical obligation is retention of underlying trade documentation (invoices, bills of lading, contracts) for AML and tax-treaty transparency purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (BMI) – Majuro Head Office
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Operational USD Account with SWIFT wire, trade finance, and U.S. correspondent clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The RMI Banking Act 2005 restricts deposit-taking, payment, and foreign-exchange clearing services to licensed banks; no offshore digital EMI (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) is licensed to operate as a settlement institution in the RMI. A fintech EMI may be used only as a pre-funded sponsor account cleared through a U.S. or E.U. partner bank, which adds OFAC and de-risking friction and provides no account protection or local regulatory remedy. This rail is acceptable for low-value outbound operating expenses (e.g., software subscriptions), but is not viable for inbound statutory capital, export trade settlement, or documentary trade finance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Effectively mandatory. Both BMI and Bank of Guam require at least one director with signing authority and each beneficial owner to attend an in-person KYC interview at the Majuro branch, or to execute a notarized/apostilled board resolution and identity verification before an RMI consular officer or licensed notary, followed by a secure video confirmation. Fully remote account opening without a notarized identity pack and verified corporate registry extract is not permitted for a non-resident Business Corporation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident beneficial ownership with no RMI physical office, payroll, or local economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Incorporation and Good Standing Certificate from the RMI Registrar (associations register); current registered agent agreement and office address; board resolution designating signatories; audited or reviewed financial statements; group organization chart; written business rationale; ISO 13485 and FDA 510(k)/EU MDR registration documentation demonstrating legitimate dental supply chain activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Paid-in share capital wire exceeding registered capital by a material margin or lacking stated economic purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder capital contribution resolution; amended articles and updated share register; share certificate; remitting bank's funds verification letter; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements signed by the shareholder; advance compliance notification to the receiving bank at least 3-5 business days before the inbound wire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: U.S. correspondent bank OFAC and de-risking scrutiny triggered by RMI's historic offshore-sector profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete transaction chain (purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, contract); end-beneficiary sanctions screening declaration; appointment of a named RMI AML compliance officer; annual AML/CFT training records; written undertaking not to transact with sanctioned jurisdictions or prohibited counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Classification as manufacturer (ISIC 3250) without domestic production assets or local factory presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Outsourced toll-manufacturing or contract milling agreement with a qualified ceramic processor; MDSAP and ISO 13485 certificates of the contract manufacturer; EU CE/MDR technical documentation; product liability insurance policy; executed offtake agreements with dental laboratories or distribution partners.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder funds by SWIFT MT103 in USD only from the shareholder's home jurisdiction to the RMI operational or escrow account. Field 70 (Remittance Information) must read 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION – MH_BC – BOARD RESOLUTION [DD-MMM-YYYY]'; Field 50 must identify the remitting shareholder exactly as registered. No RMI central bank approval or FX filing is required, but the receiving bank will hold or reject transfers lacking the share register, capital resolution, and source-of-funds evidence; transactions at or above USD 10,000 trigger reporting under the Currency and Transactions Reporting Act, and U.S. correspondent screening may delay clearing. Pre-notify the bank's compliance unit in writing and provide the corporate good-standing certificate before instructing the wire.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103/TT for supplier prepayments and settlement amounts below USD 500,000, with Field 70 stating 'PAYMENT FOR DENTAL CAD/CAM ZIRCONIA BLOCKS – INV [number]'; require the beneficiary bank's BIC and confirm the corresponding U.S. clearing bank to avoid routing delays. For larger or contractual deliveries, issue an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 through Bank of Guam's trade desk, confirmed by an advising bank in the supplier's jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen, or Hamburg); where confirmation cost is prohibitive, use documentary collections (D/P or D/A) with full shipping document sets. Every outbound payment must be backed by invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, and certificate of origin to pass bank know-your-transaction reviews.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) executed offshore in Hong Kong or Singapore via a licensed bank (no RMI domestic FX market exists)
USD/EUR deliverable FX forward via Bank of Guam or a senior U.S. correspondent bank, tenor up to 12 months
USD/CNH Cross-Currency Swap (CCS) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement for hedging CNY-denominated trade payables
USD/JPY FX swap for one-off dental milling equipment imports from Japan, executed at the offshore treasury level and limited to hedge-only positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Return and Payment for Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 December (calendar-year deadline); first filing prorated from incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs statutory penalty of 10% of unpaid franchise tax per month or partial month; continued non-payment for 90 days after notice triggers administrative strike-off by the Registrar

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report / Confirmation of Directors, Officers, Registered Office and Share Capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 December, simultaneously with the franchise tax payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the annual report leads to delinquency status, loss of good standing, late penalties and potential administrative dissolution after 30 days notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory external audit for a non-resident, non-public Marshall Islands Business Corporation; audit is required only by shareholder resolution, lender covenant, or Registrar order for cause (e.g., financial irregularity or insolvency proceeding)
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial records must accurately reflect transactions in line with either IFRS or US GAAP as the governing framework; financial statements are prepared as required by shareholders, not filed with the Registrar

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate UBO annual return is filed with the Registrar. The registered agent must maintain beneficial ownership records and annually confirm their completeness and accuracy. Any shareholding transfer requires immediate updating of the UBO register and a fresh confirmation by the registered agent.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not normally required; if voluntarily undertaken, 3,000–8,000 per year

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not impose corporate income tax, capital gains tax, branch profits tax, or any turnover-based tax on Business Corporations organized under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCCA). A 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies only to business revenue physically derived from activity within the RMI (domestic-source revenue); a non-resident BC whose dental CAD/CAM zirconia block manufacturing, sales, and global distribution occur entirely outside the RMI generates no RMI-source revenue and therefore bears a 0% effective tax rate. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because no income tax is levied; the only recurring fiscal cost is the annual BCCA registration/report fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report Form (Form AR) prescribed under Section 90 of the Business Corporations Act 1990; filed electronically via the RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations (ORC) e-filing portal at orc.gov.mh or through the RMI-licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; no quarterly, provisional, or final corporate income tax returns exist under the RMI zero-tax regime.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Every Business Corporation must file its annual report during the statutory window commencing 1 October and ending no later than 30 November of each calendar year; a newly incorporated BC files its first annual report in the calendar year next following incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 1 - Corporation Name and File Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the non-resident Business Corporation and its RMI file number as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name registered with the ORC; for this scope enter the BC as 'Dental CAD/CAM Zirconia Block Manufacturing Co.' or the entity's registered corporate style.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in the Marshall Islands (Majuro or Ebeye), stating the island and lot or building details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A post-office box alone is insufficient; the non-resident BC must maintain a real, physical registered office address available during normal business hours.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, full RMI address, and licensed agent number of the RMI-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for every non-resident BC; the agent must be a natural person resident in the RMI or an RMI-licensed corporate services provider.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 4 - Authorized Capital and Share Structure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of authorized share capital, number of shares by class or series, par value (if any), and details of issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital may be expressed in USD; RMI imposes no minimum capital requirement and permits 100% non-resident ownership without exchange-control approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, nationalities, residential addresses, and corporate office titles of all directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and officers may reside anywhere; RMI does not require local directors for a standard BC, but each foreign address must be stated in full for regulatory tracking.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Concise description of the corporation's actual or intended commercial business activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For this scope enter: 'Manufacture and supply of biocompatible dental ceramic zirconia blocks and pre-shaded CAD/CAM milling discs (ISIC 3250; NAICS 339114)' with no overstatement of RMI footprint, because substance declarations are reviewed by foreign tax authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Notarized declaration signed by the registered agent or an authorized officer of the BC attesting to the truth of the information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident officer may execute the declaration remotely; the RMI-licensed registered agent must authenticate and submit the filing to the ORC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Report by 30 November triggers assessed late penalties (commonly US$100 per month of continued delinquency) plus accrual of outstanding annual report fees; chronic non-filing leads to administrative dissolution or strike-off by the ORC. Reinstatement requires formal application, satisfaction of all accrued fees and penalties, and issuance of a fresh Certificate of Good Standing; any transaction undertaken while dissolved is ultra vires and exposes directors to personal liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI does not impose any dividend withholding tax, income tax, or branch remittance tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands has not concluded any comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) with any jurisdiction; the Compact of Free Association and Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) cover information exchange, mutual legal assistance, and trade, not income-tax relief. There is therefore no DTA relief protocol, no treaty rate to invoke, and no RMI tax-residence certificate (TRC) procedure because no income tax is collected. Non-resident shareholders should obtain a Certificate of Existence or Certificate of Good Standing from the ORC to evidence valid corporate status; any withholding tax imposed by the shareholder's residence jurisdiction cannot be reduced by an RMI treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% on both royalty and interest payments made by an RMI Business Corporation to non-residents. Treaty rates: none available because the RMI has no DTA network; cross-border lending or IP-licensing structures involving the dental consumables business must therefore be defended under the domestic tax law of the recipient's jurisdiction, not under RMI treaty protection.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable (reporting currency: USD). The RMI has no transfer pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File obligations, and no arm's-length documentation threshold under domestic law. Nevertheless, related-party pricing for the cross-border purchase of zirconia blocks, milling discs, and raw materials will be tested under the transfer pricing rules and CbC reporting obligations of the parent group's market jurisdictions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019 and its Economic Substance Regulations impose a substance test on RMI-registered entities carrying on 'relevant activities': banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, distribution/service centres, and IP holding. Manufacturing of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks (ISIC 3250) is not a listed relevant activity and attracts no formal ESR filing; however, the BC must still evidence genuine board oversight, operational decision-making, and physical capacity (e.g., quality control, warehousing, contracting with dental laboratories) sufficient to defeat sham/shell characterization in foreign CFC and economic-substance reviews, and to preserve substance defenses if IP royalties or distribution-centre functions are later appended to the dental block value chain.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking the dental zirconia block manufacturing margin into a non-resident RMI shell while all fabrication, procurement, and sales functions occur in the market jurisdiction, or issuing back-to-back purchase/sales invoices that misstate the transacting entity's commercial role to conceal taxable profits from the true operating country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In the RMI: deregistration of the BC, revocation of the Certificate of Good Standing, and loss of any medical-device manufacturing license. In counterpart jurisdictions: recharacterization of the RMI entity under CFC, GAAR, and substance-over-form rules; assessment of back taxes at statutory rates (typically 20–35%), interest, and penalties up to 100–150% of tax assessed; criminal tax-fraud prosecution in the manufacturing destination country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil on a finding of fraud, rendering directors who approved the sham transactions jointly and severally liable for full civil restitution of the evaded taxes; foreign arrest warrants can trigger RMI extradition cooperation, resulting in travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and custodial sentences in high-value fraud cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a letterbox presence (registered agent only), failing to keep board minutes, executing dental-block distribution contracts with no RMI-based employees, bank account, or warehouse, and simultaneously claiming tax-residence or treaty-shopping benefits in the U.S. or EU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off under BCCA for non-filing, denial of the ORC Certificate of Good Standing, and inclusion on restrictive tax-haven watchlists; under foreign law, withholding agents impose the maximum non-treaty rate (e.g., 30% U.S. withholding) plus penalties; OECD/EU listings can subject every inbound wire transfer to enhanced due-diligence levies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue to trade knowing the BC lacks substance face liability for fraudulent misrepresentation to banks and trade counterparties; in EU/UK enforcement actions, director disqualification, travel bans, and worldwide asset freezes are routinely sought.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain and timely update the Beneficial Ownership Register with the ORC, executing Swift/Wire or TT transfers to or from sanctioned medical distributors, or using layered nominee shareholders to obscure the ultimate beneficial owner of the dental ceramic business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the RMI AML/CFT framework and Financial Action Team directives include monetary fines for non-registration, suspension or revocation of corporate registration, and freezing of correspondent banking access; counterpart banks may terminate USD clearing relationships and file Suspicious Activity Reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers are personally exposed to criminal fines and imprisonment for knowingly filing false beneficial-ownership particulars or laundering the proceeds of healthcare supply fraud; civil suits by affected dental clinics may attach the directors' non-RMI assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Trading While Dissolved / Annual Return Default
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Continuing to manufacture or sell dental CAD/CAM blocks after the Registrar has administratively dissolved the BC for unpaid annual report fees or failure to file the annual report for two consecutive years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: BCCA invalidation of corporate capacity: contracts concluded after dissolution are legally ineffective; the ORC may deny reinstatement and the BC forfeits the limited-liability shield; foreign buyers may reject deliveries on the ground that the seller lacks legal personality.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: All debts and liabilities arising after dissolution become the personal liability of the directors and officers who authorized the transactions; this strict statutory liability cannot be waived and coexists with negligence claims from trade creditors and dental laboratory clients.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing U.S. Form W-8BEN-E or equivalent foreign forms claiming a false tax-residence or treaty benefit for the RMI BC (e.g., claiming the U.S.–RMI Compact creates an income-tax treaty, or asserting an RMI 'TRC' that does not exist) to avoid 30% U.S. withholding on royalties or dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The uncollected 30% U.S. withholding is restored with interest; the U.S. IRS may assert perjury-related civil fraud penalties of 75% of the underpaid tax and refer the BC's principals for criminal prosecution under U.S. false-statement provisions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual officers who signed or certified erroneous Forms W-8BEN-E face personal monetary penalties, civil fraud liability, and potential indictment; U.S. Treasury restrictions may impose travel bans and asset freezes through the OFAC sanctions framework.
